summary: Oxford Square Capital Corp. filed an 8-K to report quarterly financial results and declared monthly distributions on common stock. The filing contains routine operational updates: NAV per share of $1.29, NII of $5.1 million, and distributions of $0.035 per share for October, November, and December 2026. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign is present. The board declared ordinary dividends, making this a standard earnings and dividend announcement. Thus, no special-situation classification applies.
